symptoms.title: Symptom guide
symptoms.description: General information about 10 common symptoms. This is not AI and not a diagnosis.
symptoms.causes: Possible causes to discuss with a doctor
symptoms.urgent: One or more of these symptoms can need urgent care.
symptoms.notListed: If you feel very unwell or your symptom isn't listed, see a doctor. In an emergency, call 1122 or 115.
symptoms.disclaimer: This guide is for initial information only. See a doctor for a diagnosis.

headache.label: Headache
headache.advice: Rest in a dark room. Stay hydrated. Take OTC pain relief if needed. See a doctor if persistent.

fever.label: Fever
fever.advice: Monitor temperature. Stay hydrated. Take paracetamol. Seek medical help if above 103°F.

cough.label: Cough
cough.advice: Stay hydrated. Use honey and warm water. Avoid irritants. See doctor if cough persists >2 weeks.

chestPain.label: Chest pain
chestPain.advice: SEEK IMMEDIATE MEDICAL ATTENTION. Call emergency services if accompanied by shortness of breath.

stomachPain.label: Stomach pain
stomachPain.advice: Eat bland foods. Avoid spicy food. Stay hydrated. See doctor if pain is severe or persistent.

backPain.label: Back pain
backPain.advice: Apply heat/ice. Gentle stretching. Maintain good posture. See doctor if numbness develops.

dizziness.label: Dizziness
dizziness.advice: Sit or lie down safely. Drink water. Avoid sudden movements. See doctor if frequent.

shortnessOfBreath.label: Shortness of breath
shortnessOfBreath.advice: SEEK IMMEDIATE MEDICAL ATTENTION if severe or sudden onset. Use inhaler if prescribed.

fatigue.label: Fatigue
fatigue.advice: Get adequate sleep. Eat balanced diet. Exercise regularly. See doctor if persistent.

jointPain.label: Joint pain
jointPain.advice: Rest the affected joint. Apply ice. Take anti-inflammatory medication. See doctor if swelling persists.

phq9.title: Depression screening (PHQ-9)
phq9.description: Nine questions about the last two weeks. It takes about two minutes.
phq9.privacy: Your answers stay on this device and are not sent anywhere.
phq9.englishOnly: The questions are shown in English, the language of the validated PHQ-9 wording used here.
phq9.stem: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?
phq9.answerAll: Answer all 9 questions to see your results.
items: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
Feeling tired or having little energy
Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way

minimal.label: Minimal
minimal.advice: Your mental health appears to be in a good state. Keep maintaining healthy habits.

mild.label: Mild
mild.advice: Mild symptoms detected. Consider self-care activities: exercise, meditation, talking to friends.

moderate.label: Moderate
moderate.advice: Moderate depression symptoms. We recommend consulting a mental health professional.

moderatelySevere.label: Moderately severe
moderatelySevere.advice: Significant depression symptoms. Please seek professional help as soon as possible.

severe.label: Severe
severe.advice: Severe depression detected. Please contact a mental health professional or crisis helpline immediately.

phq9.disclaimer: This is a screening questionnaire, not a diagnosis. Talk to a mental health professional for an assessment.

crisis.title: You mentioned thoughts of harming yourself or of being better off dead
crisis.body: You don't have to face this alone. Please talk to someone today.
crisis.danger: If you are in immediate danger, call 1122 or 115 now.

rozan.name: Rozan Counseling Helpline
rozan.hours: Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm

vitals.title: Vital signs check
vitals.description: Enter any readings you have. Each one is compared with the usual adult range.
vitals.privacy: Your readings stay on this device and are not saved.

summary.normal: All your vital signs are normal. Keep up healthy habits.
summary.warning: Some vital signs are outside the normal range. Consult a doctor.
summary.critical: Get medical help immediately! Some vital signs are in a dangerous range.

vitals.disclaimer: This tool is for monitoring only and can't replace a professional medical check-up.
